{{Quote|A ship looks like a stock freighter but she's leaking a vapor trail on her approach, and the Rampa Skywatch figures she's a water smuggler. They shoot at her when she won't heave to, but she dumps her load, maybe five thousand liters, and cuts deeper into the traffic pattern.|[[Sonniod/Legends|Sonniod]] to [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]]|<ref name="HSR">''[[Han Solo's Revenge]]''</ref>}}
The '''Rampa Skywatch''' was a space military unit<ref name="TCSWE" /> of the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]].<ref name="TEA" /> It was tasked to intercept [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] along the [[Rampa Rapids]].<ref name="TCSWE" /> Due to the lack of water on the world [[Rampa III]], the route was used by smugglers to supply the planet from the nearby planet [[R'alla]]. However, it was strictly controlled by CSA [[Gunship/Legends|gunships]].<ref name="TEA" />

==History==
{{Quote|Last I heard, you two took some fire on the Rampa Rapids.|[[Sonniod/Legends|Sonniod]] to Han Solo|<ref name="HSR" />}}
A few year before the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] transported [[R'alla mineral water/Legends|R'alla mineral water]] to Rampa III.<ref name="HSR" />
